action.prompt: Sync spec changes to git. Steps: 1) Run 'git status specs/' to show changed spec files (requirements.md, test-plan.md, etc.). 2) Ask the user to confirm a commit message. 3) Run 'git add specs/'. 4) Run 'git commit -m "<confirmed message>"' with the user-provided message. 5) Run 'git push origin <current-branch>'. Do NOT proceed without user confirmation.

notes: Designed for roles that may not be comfortable with git CLI. Triggered by user request, not automatically.
